name: hugohe3/ppt-master
title: hugohe3/ppt-master
summary: AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks, with native shapes, transitions and animations, data-backed charts and tables on demand, audio narration from speaker notes, and support for your own .pptx templates. · by Hugo He

possibilities.connection: ppt-master produces editable .pptx decks with narration and house templates, Audio8 is a 0.6B voice model small enough for modest hardware, and MOSS-Image follows a set layout locally, so a full narrated deck could be rebuilt on one workstation.
